semantic.justification: Original ICU78.3 ucmndata keeps separate offset and pointer prefix binary searches, first/last prefix priming, unsigned byte comparison, original count/length/status behavior and CmnD/ToCP dispatch. udata_checkCommonData retains source header/major checks, early incoming-error return and close on invalid data, without new size/sort/content validation. The actual LibreOffice Makefile generates ToCP with gencmn -S, genccode and genbrk; its C pointer relocations bind direct managed name/data references at exact table addresses. DataHeader carries this platform relocation binding, and normalization preserves it when advancing the original alignment double. No callback/provider table, CmnD-only conversion or fake loader is introduced. Original native generator outputs and unchanged checker/dispatch compare 1938 complete input/output/header traces, including 144-byte copyright-bearing CmnD headers, static pointer alignment prefixes, null/empty/one-entry/unsorted tables, negative entry lengths, incoming errors and ignored lookup statuses. Raw native pointer ABI, unreadable/unbound pointer spans, physical allocation/mapping and full udata application-cache/open, iterator/engine/service installation remain unverified.
